faq.title: Your questions, answered
items: Do I need to be a limited company to have the app under my brand?
No. Your app carries your logo, colours and name whether you're a sole trader or a company, whatever the size of your gym.
Is the website really included?
Yes. We build you a custom website with your team, your equipment, your photos and your prices, with online sign-up and payment. Domain and hosting are included too.
What does the visit include?
We come to your gym, measure the premises, study the floor plan and advise you on where each device goes and which access system suits you. It's free.
How often do you come back?
Once you're live, we come back to your gym at least every three months to review every feature with you and see what can be improved.
Can I open 24 hours without staff?
Yes, if you want to. Members sign up, pay and get in on their own, and you control everything from the panel. We plan it with you based on your premises and hours.
How do I stop people sneaking in?
With the 3D sensor, if more people pass than entries granted, an alarm sounds in the gym and the person who opened the door is recorded. With a camera, every alarm is saved on video.
Which access system suits me?
It depends on your gym. We can install QR, face recognition, wristbands or cards, a turnstile or a 3D sensor, or combine them. At the visit we recommend what makes sense for you.
What if the power or internet goes down?
With the Complete pack, a UPS and a 4G router keep the door working. If your premises have poor coverage, we also offer Starlink satellite internet as an extra.
Can I ask for changes to the app?
Yes. We adapt to the way you work. We change what doesn't fit and build what you're missing for your gym.
Do my members have to download anything?
No app store needed. Members open your gym's link on their phone and add it to their home screen in a couple of taps.
Can I bring my current members?
Yes. We prepare the migration from your current software so you don't have to sign anyone up by hand.
How much does it cost?
It depends on what your gym needs. We start from the packs and, after the visit, give you a fixed, tailored price.
